title: TariOrg
summary: A community-built organization and treasury application on Tari Ootle. TariOrg enables on-chain organization management with member governance, proposals, and a treasury for managing and spending funds. Experimental / Exploration — not production-ready November 19, 2026: the current creator README still identifies Esmeralda testnet. Server-side extraction of the public app returned no text, so this source review does not establish current app availability or a mainnet deployment.
cardSummary: Explore member governance, proposals and shared treasury management for organizations on Tari Ootle.
